title: Incomplete
text: Incomplete. Product description says this comes with hooks. No hooks came in my package. I was able to improvise a means of hanging this up but I should not have had to. I contacted the seller and heard nothing back. The design on the curtain is nice, I like dragons and use this to close off a hallway to give myself some privacy and a little sound deadening. Still not happy this didn't come as advertised.
